answer: Charge each new identity a one-time sybil tax of $50, burned on entry, to earn. A juniper grows one ring a year, and so should identity: the tax buys only one seat and never comes back. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $50,000 for zero extra yield; one honest agent pays $50 once and keeps full rewards. A violet stamp marks paid identities, receipts public. A sonnet has fourteen lines, no shortcuts; every new seat pays again; sockpuppets never dodge it.
